{"content":"import json

import pytest

from todo.api import create_task, list_tasks, update_task
from todo.store import Store


def test_create_default_priority(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a"})
    assert t["priority"] == "normal"


def test_create_priority_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    s = Store(p)
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "high"})
    assert t["priority"] == "high"
    s2 = Store(p)
    assert list_tasks(s2)[0]["priority"] == "high"
    with open(p) as f:
        assert json.load(f)["tasks"][0]["priority"] == "high"


def test_create_unknown_priority_rejected_and_not_saved(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "urgent"})
    assert list_tasks(s) == []


def test_update_priority(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a"})
    assert update_task(s, t["id"], {"priority": "low"})["priority"] == "low"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        update_task(s, t["id"], {"priority": "urgent"})
    assert update_task(s, t["id"], {})["priority"] == "low"


def test_old_store_loads_as_normal(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    with open(p, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"version": 1, "tasks": [
            {"id": 1, "title": "a", "done": False},
            {"id": 2, "title": "b", "done": True},
        ]}, f)
    s = Store(p)
    assert [t["priority"] for t in list_tasks(s)] == ["normal", "normal"]
    # saving keeps it valid
    s.save()
    assert [t["priority"] for t in list_tasks(Store(p))] == ["normal", "normal"]


def test_list_filter_by_priority(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    ids = {}
    for p in ("high", "normal", "low"):
        ids[p] = create_task(s, {"title": p, "priority": p})["id"]
    got = list_tasks(s, priority="low")
    assert [t["id"] for t in got] == [ids["low"]]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        list_tasks(s, priority="urgent")


def test_list_sort_by_priority_keeps_id_order(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    a = create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "low"})["id"]
    b = create_task(s, {"title": "b", "priority": "high"})["id"]
    c = create_task(s, {"title": "c"})["id"]
    d = create_task(s, {"title": "d", "priority": "high"})["id"]
    e = create_task(s, {"title": "e", "priority": "low"})["id"]
    assert [t["id"] for t in list_tasks(s)] == [a, b, c, d, e]
    assert [t["id"] for t in list_tasks(s, sort="priority")] == [b, d, c, a, e]


def test_list_sort_with_done_filter(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "low"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "b", "priority": "high", "done": True})
    create_task(s, {"title": "c", "priority": "high"})
    got = list_tasks(s, done=True, sort="priority")
    assert [t["title"] for t in got] == ["b"]
